skill.summary: Use when the user wants to practice LeetCode problems, submit solutions, or set up LeetCode integration. Covers MCP server installation, learning-guided practice flow, solution submission, and authentication.

- Set disable-model-invocation: true in skill metadata.
- Clarified credential/config requirements in skill metadata.
